The Xbox Series X|S versions of Grand Theft Auto 6 have been shrouded in mystery with not a single frame shown before launch. Well, the game has launched now and suffice to say that Xbox Series X gets a phenomenal version of the experience. Series S? Well, arguably that's more interesting from an academic standpoint - what compromises did Rockstar require to get the game running on a console with just 4TF of GPU compute, reduced memory and bandwidth? The answers are surprising - as is the nature of its impressive image quality.
